title: Samaroh member permissions
description: Shape of business_members.permissions. Every action defaults to false when absent, with ONE exception: the per-module "view_amounts" keys default to TRUE when absent — an existing permissions object written before amounts-visibility existed keeps showing amounts unchanged (backward compatible). Owners hide amounts by explicitly setting view_amounts to false; apps then mask financial figures as ₹••• wherever they would render. Owners bypass this object entirely (implicit full access). Backups are owner-only and deliberately NOT representable here.

view.description: See the calendar, booking list and booking cards.

edit.description: Edit bookings and manage date blocks.

record_payment.description: Record payments against bookings and act on payment reminders.

view_amounts.description: See financial amounts on bookings (package total, advance, balance due, payment history). ABSENT = TRUE (backward compat); set false explicitly to mask amounts as ₹•••. Presets: Viewer/Staff/Manager all leave this true — owners toggle it off per member.

manage_parties.description: Add and edit parties (people/suppliers in the ledger).

view_amounts.description: See rupee amounts on ledger entries and party balances. ABSENT = TRUE (backward compat); set false explicitly to mask amounts as ₹•••. Presets: Viewer/Staff/Manager all leave this true — owners toggle it off per member.

view.description: See current stock and transaction history.

manage_master_items.description: Add, edit and delete master items and their images.

view_amounts.description: See monetary values on inventory (item prices, transaction values, stock worth). ABSENT = TRUE (backward compat); set false explicitly to mask amounts as ₹•••. Presets: Viewer/Staff/Manager all leave this true — owners toggle it off per member.

view.description: Open the Reports section and export report PDFs/CSVs.

view_amounts.description: See financial figures in reports (revenue, expense totals, dues). ABSENT = TRUE (backward compat); set false explicitly to mask amounts as ₹••• — reports then show counts/trends only. Presets: Viewer/Staff/Manager all leave this true — owners toggle it off per member.

manage_business.description: Edit business profile, logo, invoice prefix and business settings.

manage_members.description: Invite, edit and revoke members. (Owner always can; granting this to employees is unusual.)

gcal_sync.description: Toggle and manage Google Calendar sync.
